note: Hits of tools/guard/subject-scan.mjs that have been reviewed. Each entry: file, rule, count (hits allowed in that file), reason. Fewer hits than count also fails, so a fixed entry must be deleted.

allow.reason: Judge board layouts are recognised by their fixed panel widths (776 px). It reads composed score boards, not painted subjects, and does not run in the painter.

Imports the recess, stone and ground constants from tuned/trumbull.mjs. The constants act only when the architecture preset or --recesses, --stoneblocks or --groundglaze is on; the default recipe sets none.
Imports GROUND.from from tuned/trumbull.mjs as the default of --groundfrom. It has an effect only when --groundglaze is above 0.
Writes trumbull: false into the spec of every new benchmark target, so a new subject never gets the Trumbull palette or stone tokens.
Maps short run names to crop names when importing published V4 and V5 runs. Reporting only.

V1 to V3 target list and the per-crop copy ceilings of the published tries. Scoring only. A crop with no ceiling (mittens, h36a, h34a) falls back to the loosest one (0.152, Trumbull's): recorded in the overfit review.
Picks the Ships crop for the overview figure. Reporting only.
The spec.trumbull switch: palette tokens (--paints) and architecture tokens reach only a subject whose spec says trumbull: true. Containment of fitted settings; recorded in the overfit review.
Token help text telling a model that palette tokens act only on Trumbull.
Maps short subject names to bench subject ids for the comparison page. Reporting only; never runs in the painter.
Names which published plates the comparison page shows beside each improvement note. Reporting only; never runs in the painter.
